summary_zh: 统一互斥和原子替换修复方向正确，39项通过；部分发布恢复及public调用顺序仍有缺口。
summary_en: Shared locking and atomic replacement are correct improvements and 39 tests pass; partial-publication recovery and public-call ordering remain incomplete.

findings.summary_zh: latest先发布，后续工作线/日报失败时，无回执CLI按latest新鲜直接返回，保留缺失或旧的认证段。
findings.summary_en: Publishing latest before derived files allows the no-receipt freshness guard to preserve missing or old authenticated report content after a partial failure.
findings.fix_zh: 把保护绑定实际成功发布的段身份，缺失/不匹配时恢复或明确UNKNOWN；同回执重试仍须可恢复。
findings.fix_en: Bind freshness protection to the successfully published section identity; repair or mark UNKNOWN when absent/mismatched, and allow same-receipt retry.

findings.summary_zh: public dashboard(receipt)不保存latest，两次直接调用新后旧可绕过旧观测防护。
findings.summary_en: Public dashboard(receipt) does not persist latest, so newer-then-older direct calls bypass ordering protection.
findings.fix_zh: 统一公开写入入口，或使dashboard回执模式参与同一观测顺序状态。
findings.fix_en: Unify the public write path or make receipt-bearing dashboard calls participate in the same observation-order state.
